title: Judgment Across Three Platforms
description: Aten Ra advances through tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and battle line answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards

objectives.primary: Escort a non-playable witness-priest to the upper seal without losing a Titan.
optional: Trigger at least two faction synergy actions

specialRules: Overcharge Law: standing on empowered tiles grants attack reach but increases incoming pressure.
Split Threat: two objectives resolve on opposite sides of the field.
victoryConditions: Escort a non-playable witness-priest to the upper seal without losing a Titan.

stars.one: Primary completed with one Titan standing or severe turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan Titan; special future modes may override team size explicitly.

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.
